reasons: Datadog system.load.1 is the 1-minute load average, but the candidate uses system.cpu.load_average.5m, which is the 5-minute load average. That is a different quantity.
The converter should map to the 1-minute OTel load average (system.cpu.load_average.1m) instead. Its definition is not among the provided metrics, so the candidate cannot be accepted as is.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.
